# Flashmind

> Flashmind is a browser-based collection of short memory, number, and colour games.

Flashmind is an arcade of quick puzzle rounds. It runs entirely in the browser, requires no account, and keeps scores for the current session only.

## Games

- [Number Flash](https://flashmind.cedris.io/play/number-flash): Numbered circles flash on screen; you recall their positions in numerical order.
- [Echo Calc](https://flashmind.cedris.io/play/echo-calc): You solve equations and enter the answer from earlier in the queue.
- [Color Clash](https://flashmind.cedris.io/play/color-clash): A colour word appears in mismatched ink; you pick the ink colour, not the word.
- [Digit Rush](https://flashmind.cedris.io/play/digit-rush): A digit string flashes, then you type it back in reverse order.
- [Calc Sprint](https://flashmind.cedris.io/play/calc-sprint): One equation at a time; you type each answer before the clock runs out.
